svg.title: S06-structured-sequence — source snapshot (not a runtime trace)

g.text: S06-structured-sequence — source snapshot (not a runtime trace)
Same transaction: role status, grant version and success audit
begin checks rbac:role:status and root department,
then captures the grant limit for this actor before mutation.
Set the managed Role.status. If enabled, check the proposed grants.
finish increments the grant version after the integrity check.
Capture the current roles for this actor and build the success record.
Spring commits after the service method finishes, before returning to the controller.
Denied audit events use a separate transaction.
